Bug_Title: "@Qualifier" should not be used on "@Bean" methods
Bug_Explanation: The @Qualifier annotation is used on @Bean methods in Spring Framework which is not necessary and can lead to confusion and redundancy. The bean’s name can be explicitly specified using the name attribute or derived from the method name. In this case, the @Qualifier annotation is used on @Bean methods which leads to compilation errors.
